text:
zoe_cs: Quick final check for Nebula private/VPC onboarding tomorrow 08:30 PT. Key items: egress rules for log-forwarder, cross-account KMS access, S3 mirror policy, audit retention (WORM?), and any renewal flags. Short replies pls.

paul_net: Network scan done. Forwarder sits in a private subnet behind NAT. Recommend 3 destination locks: S3 VPCE, nebula-splunk.ingest (198.51.100.77), and telemetry-redwood.internal. Suggest replacing S3 route via NAT with a gateway VPCE during cutover.

paul_net: SG egress example:
```
Type: egress
Proto: TCP
Port: 443
To:
  - vpce-0c9d8e7f (S3)
  - 198.51.100.77/32 (nebula-splunk)
  - telemetry-redwood.internal:443
```

ivy_platform: I'll prepare a tiny terraform patch for the VPCE + route table change and a bucket policy for telemetry prefix. Do they want the telemetry mirror to our central bucket in addition to their S3?

zoe_cs: They want both: primary copy to their S3 (compliance) + mirror to our central telemetry for analytics. Also asked about who holds the envelope keys.

noah_kms: Recommend Nebula create a symmetric CMK in their account. Keypolicy should grant a specific role in our aggregator account kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Enable automatic rotation annually by default. If they want shorter rotation, note costs for re-encrypting archived objects.

meera_sec: IAM mapping: provide an assume-role in Nebula account for our redwood role. Minimum perms: s3:GetObject on telemetry prefix, kms:Decrypt on CMK ARN, logs:PutLogEvents if they use CloudWatch. Add Condition restricting to aws:SourceVpc where possible. For audit: Nebula requested tamper-evident logs for 3 years. Confirm if S3 Object Lock (WORM) is required.

zoe_cs: Nebula replied: "WORM required for 3 years; legal-hold process TBD." I'll ask for details.

paul_net: Ops suggestion: enable prefix-based filtering at source and sample non-critical traces 1:10 for first 72 hours to limit egress.

ivy_platform: On client auth: our agent supports mTLS. Do they accept uploading our cert, or do they prefer we generate CSR? Also, do they have an internal CA?

zoe_cs: Nebula says they accept uploaded client certs signed by their internal CA. Asking them to share the upload process and rotation window.

infra-bot: (automated) Runbook reminder: Nebula cutover dry-run 08:30 PT tomorrow. Runbook link: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/nebula-cutover

zoe_cs: Action items before cutover: (1) Nebula to share CMK ARN, (2) Nebula to create role and provide ARN + trust policy, (3) Nebula to confirm cert upload flow and rotation window, (4) confirm S3 object-lock/WORM settings. I'll update the runbook doc and validate at the dry-run.

noah_kms: I'll post a trimmed KMS policy template in meeting notes before dry-run.

meera_sec: I'll draft the audit retention wording and list S3 ACLs to avoid.

zoe_cs: Renewal note: Nebula is on a month-to-month dev plan; usage currently low. Recommend AE outreach after week2 stable to discuss a 3-month reserved commit. Low renewal risk for now.

infra-bot: (automated) Thread archived after 1 hour of inactivity.
